segments.name: Harley-Davidson Motor Company (HDMC)
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells Harley-Davidson motorcycles, parts, accessories and apparel to retail customers through a global dealer network.
segments.evidence: HDMC designs, manufactures and sells Harley-Davidson motorcycles. HDMC also sells motorcycle parts, accessories, and apparel as well as licenses its trademarks.

segments.name: LiveWire
segments.description: Sells electric motorcycles and electric balance bikes.
segments.evidence: The decrease was primarily due to the impact of promotional incentives, partially offset by higher electric motorcycle and electric balance bike volume.

segments.name: Harley-Davidson Financial Services (HDFS)
segments.description: Provides financing and related insurance products supporting Harley-Davidson motorcycle purchases by retail customers and dealers.
segments.evidence: Other income increased largely due to a gain on sale of residual interests in securitizations, servicing income earned as a result of the HDFS Transaction, and higher net premiums earned by Eaglemark Insurance Company Ltd. (EICL), the Company's insurance captive that reinsures several Harley-Davidson-branded voluntary protection products provided by unaffiliated third parties.

revenueModel.text: HDMC earns revenue selling motorcycles, parts, accessories and apparel to retail customers primarily through independent dealers, while HDFS earns interest income on retail and wholesale finance receivables.
revenueModel.evidence: HDMC's products are sold to retail customers primarily through a network of independent dealers.
